coverage_notes: No cached passage explicitly identifies the momentum factor or momentum portfolios.
Mechanism-proxy items describe liquidity, policy, or rotation conditions without establishing a momentum-specific link.
Generic-context items should inform market-regime review but should not be presented as direct momentum evidence.

items.classification_rationale: Severe credit-market impairment and extraordinary liquidity support align with the elevated panic and liquidity-risk state.
items.extracted_passage: The Federal Reserve and Treasury launched TALF to support credit markets, noting that securitization markets were virtually shuttered and that the facility could expand substantially.
items.title: Federal Reserve and Treasury announce TALF launch

items.classification_rationale: Systemic capital and liquidity intervention amid market turbulence supports the policy and liquidity-stress mechanism.
items.extracted_passage: The Federal Reserve described AIG as systemically important and restructured assistance to improve its capital and liquidity amid continuing market turbulence.
items.title: Federal Reserve restructures assistance to AIG

items.classification_rationale: Widespread job losses reinforce the broad risk-off backdrop but do not identify a momentum mechanism.
items.extracted_passage: US payroll employment fell by 651,000 in February, unemployment rose to 8.1 percent, and job losses were widespread across major industries.
items.title: Employment Situation, February 2009

items.classification_rationale: Persistent financial stress, impaired securitization, and alternative credit tools support the liquidity-stress mechanism.
items.extracted_passage: Chairman Bernanke said financial stresses persisted, securitization markets remained impaired, and the Federal Reserve was using alternative credit tools including TALF.
items.title: Bernanke testimony on monetary policy and the economy

items.classification_rationale: The passage describes supervisory methodology without enough evidence to connect it to momentum reversal risk.
items.exclusion_reason: Bank capital assessment methodology lacks a direct momentum-risk mechanism in the cached passage.
items.title: Agencies announce bank capital assessment details

items.classification_rationale: Warnings of market disruption, asset-price declines, and constrained credit align with the elevated stress state.
items.extracted_passage: Vice Chairman Kohn warned that an AIG failure could deepen market disruption, depress asset prices, and further constrict credit, explaining the liquidity support.
items.title: Kohn testimony on American International Group

items.classification_rationale: Borrowing and term-auction usage document the liquidity environment but provide no clear directional momentum evidence.
items.extracted_passage: The H.3 release showed reserve balances and borrowings, including substantial term auction credit during the market stress episode.
items.title: Aggregate Reserves of Depository Institutions, March 5, 2009

items.classification_rationale: The scale of reserve credit and liquidity facilities is relevant to the policy mechanism but is directionally descriptive.
items.extracted_passage: The weekly balance sheet reported Reserve Bank credit and the scale of term auction credit and other liquidity facilities.
items.title: Factors Affecting Reserve Balances, March 5, 2009
